title: I built a chessboard you can solve puzzles with. Looking for 5 testers.
author: shadowosa1
selftext:
I’ve made a chessboard connected to a live AI voice.

Its main thing is puzzles. 

You can also ask it to show an opening, explain a threat, try a move, take it back, or quiz you on a position. The conversation changes what happens on the board, so you can follow a line and ask questions as you go.

For example: “Show me the Italian.” Then “Why that square?” or “What happens if I move my knight here?” You can interrupt and change direction without choosing a new mode each time.

There are some sync issues with the voice and board. Waiting a second fixes it automatically. If u hear nothing. It didn't hear you. 

Knowing the language of chess is needed. Pawn take. E4 to E5. Capture, etc. You get the point. 

Just click think. 3mins on me. thanks guys. no sign in required. 

[https://www.thinkspatial.ai/chess](https://www.thinkspatial.ai/chess)

Please, tell me ur frustrations with it.
